notes:
1. 优化智能云存档的启动保护逻辑，减少正常启动游戏后产生同步冲突的概率。
2. 仅在软件启动时检测到游戏已经运行的情况下启用上传保护，避免覆盖可能已被游戏读取的旧存档。
3. 正常检测到游戏新启动时仍会自动下载云端存档，但不再默认阻止游戏结束后的自动上传。
4. 新增每个游戏独立的存档自动同步开关，默认开启。
5. 游戏详情页新增存档自动同步此游戏开关，可单独控制某个游戏是否参与云存档同步。
6. 关闭单个游戏同步后，该游戏会跳过智能云存档监控、同步全部和自动同步重试。
7. 手动同步已关闭同步的游戏时，会提示先在游戏详情页开启同步。
8. 保留原有全局存档自动同步开关，新增单游戏开关作为二级控制。
9. Optimized the Smart Cloud Save startup protection logic to reduce unnecessary sync conflicts after normal game launches.
10. Only enable upload protection when the app starts while a game is already running, preventing possible overwrites of saves that may have already been loaded by the game.
11. When a newly launched game is detected normally, the app still downloads the cloud save automatically, but no longer blocks automatic upload after the game exits by default.
12. Added a per-game save sync toggle, enabled by default.
13. Added a Save Sync for This Game toggle on the game detail page, allowing each game to be included in or excluded from cloud save sync independently.
14. When per-game sync is disabled, that game is skipped by Smart Cloud Save monitoring, Sync All, and automatic sync retries.
15. Manual sync for a game with sync disabled now shows a prompt asking the user to enable sync first.
16. Kept the existing global automatic save sync toggle; the new per-game toggle works as a secondary control.
